mechanism.mechanism_of_action: Folate receptor alpha (FRα)-targeted antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) loaded with topoisomerase 1 inhibitor (TOP1i), delivering cytotoxic payload to FRα-expressing tumor cells

clinical.indications: Ovarian cancer (FRα-expressing), other FRα-positive solid tumors

market.market_position: Next-generation FRα-targeted ADC, showed 82% ORR in preclinical models [uncertain]
